description: HD texture packs: every texture the mod makes or draws into. pictures: the ready-made HD picture the installer writes for a texture (texture: its name without folders; picture: from core/; region [x, y, width, height]: the texels it covers in a game texture the mod draws into, none for a texture of the mod's own). no_hd_source: name patterns (whole name) of the textures that have none, and why. default_scale: the size of the pictures for a pack none of whose pictures can be measured. tests/install/test_hd_coverage.py fails when a build writes a texture listed in neither.

no_hd_source.hf_horn_GSM_NOMIP: plain white, tinted by the layout: the same at any size
no_hd_source.lby_paper_BM_MQ_NOMIP: the single-screen world map's parchment: a photo no larger than the texture
no_hd_source.cmn_micon_BM_MQ_NOMIP: the new and ported monsters' icons: 36 px art (MH World's, MH XX's); enlarged smoothly
no_hd_source.qst_icon_BM_MQ_NOMIP: Bubbleblight's icons: MH Generations' 12 x 16 art; enlarged smoothly
no_hd_source.m2[89]a\\d+_ID: Misty Peaks' area maps: MH XX's art
no_hd_source.m2[89]d_ID: Misty Peaks' whole map: MH XX's art
